text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence spreads into daily life. One major concern is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating all people equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI systems often collect personal information. People need to know how their data is used and protected. Transparency matters too: we should understand how AI reaches its decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that keep technology safe, honest, and helpful for everyone in society.
